notes.title: Version 0.1.1-6a "Developer Branch Only" Patch Notes

Version 0.1.1-6a has been made live in the "Developer Branch". 

Our Developer Branch is for the highly  experimental stuff and we expect this branch to have bugs and issues, but we need it on Steam for our testing purposes. 

If you want the latest, but necessarily the greatest, reach out to us on Discord and we will share the password. Of course if you do get in this branch we would love any bug reports, feedback, opinions, etc. so we can get as much corrected before we post it to the Beta Branch.

notes.title: 0.0.8-4a Update
notes.content:
Hey, just another quick heads up to those of you testing the alpha before we go live in Early Access.

We pushed a the next build. 

There is an issue with the 80's outbreak level as the light bake data was removed.  Since it is a visual only issue (and yes it does look really bad lit with no shadows) we decided to proceed with publishing this update.

The list of changes, that show up in the main menu, has not been updated with the changes for this version.

Also a reminder, If you haven't done so already, please make sure you join us on our discord to keep up with the progress and known issues list.

[url=https://discord.gg/zxAKGeN]Tybug Studios Discord[/url]

notes.title: 0.0.8-2a Mid Cycle Update
notes.content:
Hey, just a quick heads up to those of you testing the alpha before we go live in Early Access.

We pushed a mid cycle build, that was not fully vetted, per request of some testers so they could get some of the latest fixes without having to wait.  As we are not live in Early Access yet and don't have a beta/test branch set up in Steam yet we felt it Ok to facilitate this request in the "live" channel.

The list of changes, that show up in the main menu, has not been updated with the changes for this version, they are still for the 0.0.8-1a.  

Also a reminder, If you haven't done so already, please make sure you join us on our discord to keep up with the progress and known issues list.
